input.summary: Add Subparagraph 22.7 overriding Paragraph 12 and Subparagraphs 22.2-22.5 so that other Parties need Teleglobe's consent (not unreasonably withheld), may never transfer to our competitor, and confirming no change-of-control termination right.
input.comment: [Playbook] Paragraph 22.1 excepts Paragraph 12 and Subparagraphs 22.2-22.5, so today every other Party has consent-free assignment and Transfer routes; new Subparagraph 22.7 overrides both routes to require our prior written consent (not to be unreasonably withheld), bars any assignment, sale or Transfer to a competitor of ours, and confirms that a change of control of Teleglobe USA Inc. gives no other Party a termination right. Our own rights under 22.3-22.5 and Paragraph 12 are untouched; we expect other Parties to press for reciprocity, and we can accept a mutual formulation if needed.

ops.text: Notwithstanding Paragraph 12 and Subparagraphs 22.2, 22.3, 22.4 and 22.5, no Party other than Teleglobe USA Inc. may assign, sell or transfer the whole or any part of its rights or obligations under this Agreement, including any Transfer under Paragraph 12, without the prior written consent of Teleglobe USA Inc., which must not be unreasonably withheld, and no such assignment, sale or transfer may be made to a competitor of Teleglobe USA Inc. A change of control of Teleglobe USA Inc. does not give any other Party any right to terminate this Agreement or Teleglobe USA Inc.'s participation in it.
